boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby commercial and cultural corridors, each with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Christian's Pizza for pizza by the slice
cards.subtitle: Three Chopt Road corridor · 7003A Three Chopt Rd
cards.notes: On the Three Chopt Road corridor, order a slice or a whole pie; the shop says its dough and sauce are made from scratch daily.
cards.short_summary: A Three Chopt Road pizza stop with slices and whole pies.
cards.evidence_claim: Christian's Pizza lists 7003A Three Chopt Road and states that its dough and sauce are made from scratch daily.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant purchase required; the official site lists daily operating hours.

cards.title: Olio for a bistro-caterer stop
cards.subtitle: Three Chopt Road corridor · 8903 Three Chopt Rd, Suite E
cards.notes: Use the Three Chopt Road corridor to reach Olio; confirm its current menu or catering availability directly before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A bistro and caterer at the Three Chopt Road address listed by Olio.
cards.evidence_claim: Olio identifies itself as a bistro and caterer at 8903 Three Chopt Road, Suite E, Henrico.
cards.access_notes: Food and catering purchases are required.

cards.title: Westhampton Pastry Shop for baked goods
cards.subtitle: Patterson Avenue corridor · 5728 Patterson Ave
cards.notes: Along Patterson Avenue, stop for the bakery’s pastries, pies, cookies, breads, doughnuts, and Danish; check holiday hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Patterson Avenue bakery with a broad listed range of baked goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Westhampton Pastry Shop lists its Patterson Avenue address and says it specializes in cakes, pastries, pies, cookies, breads, doughnuts, and Danish.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; the official site advises visitors to check for holiday hours.

cards.title: Gelati Celesti for ice cream
cards.subtitle: Grove Avenue corridor · 5808 Grove Ave
cards.notes: On Grove Avenue, use the shop’s official ordering page to confirm the location and current availability before choosing an ice-cream stop.
cards.short_summary: Gelati Celesti’s Grove Avenue ice-cream location.
cards.evidence_claim: Gelati Celesti’s official ordering page lists its Grove location at 5808 Grove Avenue in Richmond.

cards.title: Conejo for daily-made flour tortillas
cards.subtitle: Patterson Avenue corridor · 5820 Patterson Ave, Suite 103
cards.notes: Head to the Patterson Avenue corridor for Conejo and its daily-made flour tortillas; verify menu and service details with the restaurant before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A Patterson Avenue restaurant documented for daily-made flour tortillas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westhampton Business Association lists Conejo at 5820 Patterson Avenue and states that it makes flour tortillas daily.

cards.title: World of Mirth for toys and activity books
cards.subtitle: West Cary Street corridor · 3005 W Cary St
cards.notes: On West Cary Street, browse the store’s toys, puzzles, dress-up items, coloring books, and activity books; check posted store hours before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Cary Street toy store with puzzles and activity books among its listed categories.
cards.evidence_claim: World of Mirth identifies itself as a toy store at 3005 West Cary Street and lists puzzles, dress-up, coloring books, and activity books.

cards.title: The Byrd for a Carytown film screening
cards.subtitle: West Cary Street corridor · 2908 W Cary St
cards.notes: Use the Cary Street corridor to find the theatre between North Sheppard Street and North Colonial Avenue, then check its schedule for a screening.
cards.short_summary: A Carytown theatre directly identified on West Cary Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Byrd Theatre states that it is located in Carytown on Cary Street between North Sheppard Street and North Colonial Avenue, at 2908 West Cary Street.
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for screenings; consult the theatre’s current showtime schedule.

cards.title: VMFA for free general admission
cards.subtitle: North Arthur Ashe Boulevard corridor · 200 N Arthur Ashe Blvd
cards.notes: Follow North Arthur Ashe Boulevard to the museum for its general collection; reserve or buy separately only if a special exhibition requires it.
cards.short_summary: A North Arthur Ashe Boulevard museum with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: VMFA lists 200 North Arthur Ashe Boulevard and states that general admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Virginia Museum of Fine Arts — Exhibition Tickets
cards.access_notes: Free general admission; special exhibitions may require tickets.

cards.title: Science Museum of Virginia for hands-on science
cards.subtitle: West Broad Street corridor · 2500 W Broad St
cards.notes: On West Broad Street, plan a visit around interactive exhibitions, the planetarium, hands-on labs, and live demonstrations listed by the museum.
cards.short_summary: A Broad Street science museum with hands-on and planetarium experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science Museum of Virginia identifies its 2500 West Broad Street location and describes interactive exhibitions, a planetarium, hands-on labs, and live demonstrations.
cards.source_title: Science Museum of Virginia — Directions & Parking
cards.access_notes: General admission tickets are required for most visitors; reserve in advance.

cards.title: Maymont for its grounds and walking paths
cards.subtitle: Westover Road corridor · 1000 Westover Rd
cards.notes: Use the Westover Road corridor to reach Maymont’s grounds, then follow its walking paths through the gardens and outdoor areas; review current site notices first.
cards.short_summary: A Westover Road estate with public grounds, gardens, and walking paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Richmond National Battlefield Park describes Maymont as a 100-acre estate at 1700 Hampton Street with gardens, wildlife exhibits, a farm, and grounds open to visitors.
cards.source_title: Richmond National Battlefield Park — Maymont information
cards.access_notes: Outdoor grounds access is documented; confirm current hours and any separate admission for indoor attractions before visiting.

warnings: Maymont’s cited government page gives a Hampton Street entrance, while a current external guide lists the Westover Road address; coordinates and maps URL are left null rather than inferring a specific entrance.
